Trailing annual = avg of COMPLETE populated months × 12 (data-driven divisor): annualIncome = round(avg(completeEarned>0)×12), annualOutgoings likewise, annualNet = annualIncome−annualOutgoings, savingsRateTrailing = round(annualNet/annualIncome×1000)/10. nodes.label: Categorisation confidence bands
nodes.formula: autoAccept ≥ 0.90 (write straight to ledger); 0.70–0.90 → review queue; < 0.70 → manual. Thresholds are per-user (UserCategorizationSettings).

nodes.formula: A signature→category pattern becomes a shared cross-user prior only after ≥ k distinct users confirm it (k=5, KB_GRADUATION_K); graduation is sticky (never demoted). Private mappings stay authoritative for their owner.

nodes.formula: Only HUMAN confirmations/corrections write to the shared KB; AI auto-accepts never re-train it; an edit weighs more than a passive confirm.

nodes.label: De-identification before shared KB
nodes.formula: Every description is scrubbed to a merchant-only signature (strip names, BSBs, card masks, transfer/payid markers) before any shared-KB read or write. No PII/CDR ever enters the community brain.

nodes.label: What-if: extra loan repayments
nodes.produces: ScenarioResult — interest saved and months reduced from adding an extra monthly repayment, plus the monthly cashflow impact.
nodes.formula: Two amortisation walks (baseline vs +extraMonthly) via walkAmortisation→calculateInterestForPeriod; interestSaved = baseline.totalInterest − accelerated.totalInterest; monthsReduced = baseline.months − accelerated.months; monthlyCashflowAfter = before − extraMonthly.
nodes.authority: Standard amortisation (M = P·r(1+r)ⁿ/((1+r)ⁿ−1)); interest per period via the canonical lib/utils/calculations primitive.

nodes.label: What-if: park cash in offset
nodes.produces: ScenarioResult — annual interest saved by adding cash to a loan offset account (liquidity preserved — offset still counts as liquid).
nodes.formula: interestBefore/After = calculateInterestForPeriod(calculateEffectivePrincipal(principal, offset[+amount]), rate, 12); monthlyInterestSaved = before − after; annualInterestSaved = monthlyInterestSaved × 12.
nodes.authority: Offset mechanics (effective principal = principal − offset) + Monitrax what-if annualisation (annual = monthly × 12).

nodes.label: What-if: refinance a loan
nodes.produces: ScenarioResult — monthly/lifetime savings and break-even months from refinancing to a new rate, net of switching costs.
nodes.formula: newMonthlyRepayment = calculatePIRepayment(principal, newRate, remainingMonths); monthlySavings = currentRepayment − newRepayment; lifetimeSavings = monthlySavings × remainingMonths − switchingCosts; breakEvenMonths = ceil(switchingCosts / monthlySavings).
nodes.authority: Standard P&I repayment formula (canonical lib/utils/calculations.calculatePIRepayment); break-even = cost / monthly saving.

nodes.label: What-if: start a monthly investment
nodes.produces: ScenarioResult — projected future value and growth of a recurring monthly investment, plus the monthly cashflow impact of the contribution.
nodes.formula: months = years × 12; monthlyReturn = annualReturn/12; FV = monthlyAmount × ((1+monthlyReturn)^months − 1)/monthlyReturn (ordinary annuity); projectedGrowth = FV − totalContributions; monthlyCashflowAfter = before − monthlyAmount.
nodes.authority: Future value of an ordinary monthly annuity; cashflow contribution held constant.

nodes.label: Loan: monthly P&I payment
nodes.produces: Monthly principal-and-interest repayment for a loan amortised over `months`.
nodes.formula: monthlyRate = annualRate/12; payment = P·r·(1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n − 1); degenerate (rate 0 OR months 0) → principal/months (or 0).
nodes.authority: Standard loan amortisation (P&I annuity) — ATO/industry-standard formulas.

nodes.label: Loan: months to payoff
nodes.produces: Number of months to fully repay a loan at a given monthly payment. Returns the NEVER_AMORTISES sentinel (999) when payment ≤ interest (interest-only); capped at 600. MON-019: the sentinel is NOT a payoff horizon — consumers (calculateExtraRepaymentImpact) MUST guard it before any arithmetic (subtracting it produced the bogus 'save 69 years').
nodes.formula: monthlyRate = annualRate/12; n = ceil( −log(1 − P·r/M) / log(1+r) ), min(n, 600); returns 999 if M ≤ P·r.
nodes.authority: Standard loan amortisation (P&I annuity) — ATO/industry-standard formulas.

So same-vendor rows differing only by time/store-number/ref collapse to one key; different-location rows stay distinct (over-merge would misstate spend-by-category, §19). Shared with POST /unified-transactions/renormalize (§12.2.1, one source).
nodes.authority: docs/blueprint/PHASE_54_NEOBRAIN.md §19A; CLAUDE.md §12.11 (name-only, non-destructive), §12.2.1 (one source shared with the renormalize route)

nodes.produces: {aiSuggested, aiMerchantsQueried, aiCapped} — for the rows the deterministic pass still missed, proposes a category SUGGESTION per merchant (never auto-filed, §54.2).
nodes.formula: Group still-unknown rows by de-identified signature (scrubToSignature; rows that scrub to nothing = transfers/PII are skipped, never sent). Durable no-repeat-call = user confirmation → merchantMapping + shared-KB graduation, not caching an unconfirmed guess (anti-echo-chamber).
